item_reviews.comment: T1 shows 56.8 vs 56.1; the 0.7-point difference is correct and is the central result.
Statistical tests list only S1 and S2. No test covers exp1/cmp1, and SDs overlap, so significance can't be claimed.
T1 gives 56.8 vs 52.3, and S1 reports a significant paired difference with CI [3.51, 5.5]. The 4.5-point gap matches the table means.
T2 gives 41.9 vs 39.6, and S2 reports p=0.0046 with CI [1.18, 3.42]. The result is secondary-set evidence.
T3 matches: Corvane is higher on train, restaurant and attraction, and lower on hotel and taxi. No tests are given, and some domains are small.
The numbers are correct, but the item is labelled as an ablation drop with no stated test. It is also a secondary result, not about Halloway.

missing_core_findings.description: Corvane-DST's advantage over Halloway-DST is small on the in-domain test set (0.7 points, with overlapping SDs of 0.6 and 1.3). It is larger on unseen-service Tarnby-Schema (2.3 points, significant). Per-domain results are mixed, so the benefit is not uniform.
